item.title: At-Risk 91-Year-Old Man in Rosemead Sought by Authorities
item.description: An at-risk 91-year-old man with memory loss was reported missing after last being seen Friday in Rosemead. Richard Rodriguez was last seen at 9:15 a.m. Friday in the 3500 block of Rosemead Boulevard, according to the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department. Rodriguez was described as Hispanic. item.title: First Measles Case Among LA County Resident Confirmed
item.description: The first measles case in a Los Angeles County resident since August has been confirmed, the Los Angeles County Department of Public Health announced Friday. The patient, who was not identified, had recently traveled internationally, according to the department. item.title: Orange County Reports New Measles Case Involving Toddler
item.description: Orange County health officials Friday reported another measles case, this time involving a toddler, just days after confirming an infection in a 19-year-old who had traveled internationally. item.description: Rallies were held Friday in Los Angeles and Orange counties by demonstrators participating in a nationwide day of action seeking to stop funding for U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement — including a downtown Los Angeles rally that began with about 1,000 people and later swelled into the tens of thousands. item.title: Man Sentenced to 138 Years to Life for Molesting 5 Girls
